### A. Predecessor Integrity & Deterministic Fixtures
- [`scripts/raisa_provider_free_check_in_native_harness_preset_mount_effective_tool_projection_rehearsal.py`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/preset-mount-tool-projection-gemini-53e1a7a2/scripts/raisa_provider_free_check_in_native_harness_preset_mount_effective_tool_projection_rehearsal.py) accurately binds all 6 predecessor files and verifies their exact SHA-256 digests and file sizes.
- Verified that the generated effective-tool guard matches accepted SHA-256 `6678ed31bdcd30a5018689b72ad509c182854bf5d63862f59b397acc8de40894`.
- Validated that canonical preset `emr4-bounded-worker` is byte-exact (158 bytes, SHA-256 `3de182eb702e6f2b397941c73393b87f65acb9b401565f966059d2bd46f649d1`).
- Root fixtures exercise 5 closed scenarios ensuring that only the corrected shipped-plus-user root configuration admits the `user`-trust EMR4 preset row.
- Guard fixtures exercise 13 closed scenarios in [`guard.scenario_matrix()`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/preset-mount-tool-projection-gemini-53e1a7a2/scripts/deepseek_native_harness_provider_free_effective_tool_composition_guard.py#L460-L517), confirming that inherited surplus tools are filtered, local tools are rejected, missing expected tools fail closed, and non-conforming schema views are sanitized into stable closed coordinates without raw error leakage.

### B. Profile Insertion Order & HMR Injection
- Patch composition in `build_patch_pair()` enforces the deterministic order of injected plugins:
  1. `agent-presets` (with `includeUserRoot: true` and default `emr4-bounded-worker`)
  2. `provider-free-effective-tool-hmr-sentinel`
  3. `provider-free-effective-tool-proof-runner` (injecting `["hmr", "agentPresets", "tools"]`)
- Injected runner config correctly passes `shippedRoot`, `userRoot`, `eventPath`, `terminalPath`, and `watchedPaths`.
- Sentinel polls HMR configs map until all watched paths are registered before emitting `stock_headless_hmr_ready`, enabling atomic swap to the test runner patch.

### C. One-Scope / One-Guard Lifecycle & Failure Classification
- In `runner_source()`:
  - Exactly one scope is instantiated via `createScope(ctx, Object.freeze({}))`.
  - Exactly one call to `assertEffectiveToolComposition(scope.ctx, "emr4-bounded-worker", ["edit", "glob", "read"])` is performed.
  - No `agents.create`, session IDs, followup turns, broker or provider objects are ever imported or referenced.
  - Fail-closed root-vs-post-root classification: An explicit `rootsPassed` boolean guards the catch handler. Failures before root validation preserve `ROOT_FAILURE_CODE` (`EFFECTIVE_ROOT_ROSTER_MISMATCH`), while errors during guard execution are mapped through `sanitizeEffectiveToolTerminal(error)` to closed coordinates and safe tool names (`edit`, `glob`, `read`).
  - Scope disposal is guaranteed in the `finally` block with failure fallback to `EFFECTIVE_TOOL_SCOPE_DISPOSAL_FAILED`.

### D. Checkpoint, Consumption, and Lifecycle Safety
- Native execution is gated on `load_checkpoint()` requiring `native-preexecution-checkpoint.json` with status `"admitted"`, matching candidate commit hash, and passing review receipt binding.
- Exclusive creation (`xb`) of `native-consumed.json` occurs prior to process launch, enforcing single-process execution and 0 retries.
- Process execution is strictly contained: 75s deadline, PID-targeted termination, and recursive cleanup of disposable roots with root-escape validation (`root.parent != parent`).
- Exclusive terminal creation (`openSync(..., "wx")`) ensures atomic, un-tampered terminal recording.
- Event sequence parser verifies that all 9 expected lifecycle events occur in strict monotonic order with zero duplicates.

### E. Schemas and Zero-Boundary Enforcement
- [`deterministic-evidence.schema.json`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/preset-mount-tool-projection-gemini-53e1a7a2/orchestration/continuity/raisa-provider-free-check-in-native-harness-preset-mount-effective-tool-projection-rehearsal/deterministic-evidence.schema.json) and [`native-terminal.schema.json`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/preset-mount-tool-projection-gemini-53e1a7a2/orchestration/continuity/raisa-provider-free-check-in-native-harness-preset-mount-effective-tool-projection-rehearsal/native-terminal.schema.json) strictly enforce `additionalProperties: false`.
- Enforces exact constants:
  - `package_only_node_processes: 1`, `native_harness_processes: 0` (for deterministic stage)
  - `native_process_count: 1`, `automatic_retry_count: 0` (for native terminal stage)
  - Zero constants for `agent_session_count`, `turn_count`, `broker_request_count`, `model_request_count`, `provider_request_count`, `occupied_worker_count`, `docker_invocation_count`, `database_invocation_count`.
  - `raw_logs_retained: false`, `raw_environment_retained: false`.
  - Passing terminals require `terminal_code: "EFFECTIVE_TOOL_COMPOSITION_PASSED"`, exact 9-event sequence, and exactly `["edit", "glob", "read"]`.
